title: Review and gate on packages
summary: Answers Robert's request of 1 November 2026. Batches stay pairs because the look-ahead planner caps its target at the cards it can see, an idle gate host skips the deadline, the arrival forecast sees almost nothing, and at about 2.6 gated merges per day a partner arrives within 15 minutes about 5 % of the time; non-batched cards pay two full suites. Gate package: the post-merge T3 window of the accepted D1. Review package: one Dossier wave for the context-heavy aspects, with build, T1, deterministic checks and requirement fit per card and one verdict per member. D1 activation saves about 31 to 42 runner-hours a week and 33 to 66 minutes per card; parallel Remote Review aspects save more review wall time than packaging; packages save 15 to 33 % of package-tier tokens and add a cross-card check. Nine decisions PK1 to PK9 and six slices; first step: activate post-merge testing for Agent Studio.

# Activate post-merge testing for Agent Studio: T1 replay, post-merge timers, window settings, mode switch

Source of truth: `docs/review-gate-packages/index.html` (AGT-3400). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. First step; sections 08 and 06, decisions PK1, PK2 and PK8. Implements D1 T-B of AGT-3276 for Agent Studio.

## Deliver

1. Replay T1: run the per-card affected selection (`testing.perCard: affected`) on the last 20 Agent Studio review plans and record median and p90 minutes. Under PK2 A, continue when the median is at most 20 minutes and p90 at most 30 minutes; otherwise stop, report, and keep pre-merge.
2. Install the post-merge timers on `agent-runner-01` following `docs/operations/setup/linux-runner-host.md` (Post-merge develop checks). The templates name `User=agent-runner` and `/home/agent-runner`, which do not exist on this host (the runner runs as `agent`). Add a systemd drop-in per unit for user, group and `ReadWritePaths` instead of editing the templates; create the dedicated checkout and the env file `/etc/agent-runner/post-merge-agent-studio.env` with a Runner service token file. Run `post-merge-run --dry-run --mode window` and attach the output.
3. Through the API (Owner role), set Agent Studio batch gate `overlap: adjacent`, `maximumSize: 6`, `lookAheadMinutes: 30`, sending the full settings body because PUT resets omitted fields. In post-merge mode these size the T3 window (`PostMergeRunEndpoints.cs:31-37`).
4. `PUT /api/projects/Agent%20Studio/testing` with mode `post-merge`.
5. Update the sentence in `docs/system/domains/pipeline.md` ("Agent Studio remains in pre-merge until ...") with the measured replay and the applied PK2 option, and add one row for this Dossier to `docs/start/README.md` (the concept run could change only its own directory).
6. Report after 72 hours: full-suite runs, gate minutes per card, integration minutes per card, red develop incidents and fallbacks to pre-merge.

## Acceptance criteria

- The delivery report states the T1 replay median and p90 over the last 20 Agent Studio review plans and the PK2 option applied.
- `systemctl list-timers` on agent-runner-01 shows `agent-post-merge-window@agent-studio.timer` and `agent-post-merge-nightly@agent-studio.timer`; a dry run and the first real window receipt are attached.
- The PUT response and the project settings page show testing mode post-merge with perCard affected; the board header shows the develop state.
- After the switch no new `logs/batch-fallback-*.json` evidence appears for Agent Studio cards, and gate economics reports full-suite runs per day.
- Rollback (`testing.mode: pre-merge`) is documented in the report and was not needed, or its use is reported.

Out of scope: planner code changes (S6), review changes (S3 to S5).

Rules: tests inject the clock (TestClockGuardTests), every ProcessStartInfo sets CreateNoWindow = true, no empty catch blocks, no whole-file line-ending rewrites, component-size baselines must not rise. Builds and tests run remotely. Report the result SHA in status.md.

# Package review live: two tiers, per-member settlement, masking invalidation, sampling

Source of truth: `docs/review-gate-packages/index.html` (AGT-3400). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Sections 03 to 05, decisions PK4, PK6 and PK9. Promote only after the S4 shadow report and when S2 shows at least 30 % of reviewed cards with a Dossier.

## Deliver

1. Review plan per card: card check (build, T1 selection, lint and format, path scope against the slice `acceptanceScope`, requirement fit). Cards with a Dossier skip the package-tier aspects in their per-card plan and join a package; cards without one keep today's plan.
2. Settlement submits one typed fact per member through the existing decision path (`TransitionDecisionPolicy`, `AiOperatorDecisionGateway`); do not add transition rules outside `orchestration-decisions/`.
3. A member returning from rework runs its card check and a scoped package review of its own delta, or joins a forming package of the same Dossier.
4. Masking invalidation on ejection as in section 04.
5. Sampling: 1 in 5 members also run the full per-card review in shadow for 2 weeks; record comparisons; enforce the PK9 abort rule.
6. In post-merge mode the review runs no test beyond T1; `tests-and-evidence` judges evidence only.
7. Document the tiers in `docs/system/domains/review.md`.

- Decision-library tests: a package with one failing and two passing members moves the passing members to integration and the failing one to 2-ready within its own round budget; no member waits for another.
- Ejecting a member invalidates the package verdict of members sharing files and triggers a scoped re-review of their own diff on the new base.
- With `review.package: off` review plans are byte-identical to today.
- The two-week sampling report states the miss rate; above 1 missed blocking finding per 20 members the project setting falls back to off and an operator-feed event is raised.
